name: Novotel Lombok Resort & Villas
short_description: A 77-room resort with 25 private villas in traditional Sasak style, on a private white-sand beach in the Mandalika Resort area with 3 outdoor pools.
ai_summary: Novotel Lombok Resort & Villas sits within the Mandalika Resort area on Pantai Putri Nyale, offering 77 rooms and 25 private villas built in traditional Sasak style set among tropical gardens. The resort has its own private white-sand beach and three outdoor pools, alongside the all-day Spice Market restaurant with unlimited barbecue, the beachfront Breeze Bar, a fitness center, spa, water sports, and an on-site dive center. Guests consistently praise the traditional design touches, the private beach, and free daily activities, making it a family-friendly and romantic-getaway option alike.

faqs.question: Does Novotel Lombok Resort & Villas have a private beach?
faqs.answer: Yes -- the resort sits on a private white-sand beach within the Mandalika Resort area, alongside three outdoor pools.

faqs.question: Does Novotel Lombok Resort & Villas have villas?
faqs.answer: Yes -- 25 private villas in traditional Sasak style complement the 77 main-building rooms, all set among tropical gardens.
